_meta.purpose: Slots that lack the subsurface terrain required by emerge_from_ground chr intros. Placing an emerge-anim chr here CTDs the game on cell load or cleanup (the animation tries to push the chr up from beneath the floor, but there's no floor to push from at elevated platforms / ramparts / rooftops).
_meta.gate_logic: If (msb, pi) is in this set AND target_cp has V3_ENTRANCE_ANIM_CLASS == 'emerge_from_ground', reject the placement. Targets without that classification (default: 'unknown') pass through.

interaction_with_other_systems.V3_PROBLEM_SLOTS: Independent. A slot can be both no-emerge AND in V3_PROBLEM_SLOTS (Fort GG is both). The two gates compose: V3_PROBLEM_SLOTS restricts to SAFE_CONFIRMED + EXTRA_ALLOWS; V3_NO_EMERGE_SLOTS rejects emerge-class regardless.
interaction_with_other_systems.V3_PROBLEM_SLOT_EXTRA_BANS: Overlapping. Fort GG explicitly bans c4441/c4810/c4811 via EXTRA_BANS AND this new system would catch them via entrance_anim. Belt-and-suspenders is fine — EXTRA_BANS is more specific (per-slot), this is per-class.
interaction_with_other_systems.long_term: If a chrbnd parser (Option C) derives entrance_anim systematically, this slot list should remain manual — it's geometry-dependent and shouldn't be derived from chr data.

_meta.growth_pattern: Add slots empirically as emerge-anim CTDs surface at new locations. Geometric pre-population is possible (any slot Y > X with no overhead structure), but conservative manual entry is safer until validated.
